name: Sam bo luong
summary: Sâm bổ lượng is a sweet soup taken as a drink, an after-dark order on Da Nang’s Phạm Hồng Thái beside mì Quảng, ốc hút, smoothies, and chè.
origin: Sold across Vietnam. In Da Nang it is a Phạm Hồng Thái night order.
howToEat: Order a glass on the night street after the noodles.
where: Phạm Hồng Thái, after dark, from about 17:00 until after 23:00.
seoTitle: Sam bo luong — a night drink on Pham Hong Thai
seoDescription: Sâm bổ lượng is a sweet soup served as a drink, an evening order on Phạm Hồng Thái in Da Nang with chè and smoothies.
